notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» gives the father by relation only, with no name: a relation link (rule 7); «جَمَاعَةُ مَشَايِخِي» is unnamed and co-transmits with him
«عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ (ع)» names the Imam after «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2), and the saying «خَلَقَ اللَّهُ» is his report
«(رحمه الله)» is a blessing, left out
